requirements.desc: `senti plugin update` without a plugin name must compute and display enabled installed plugin update candidates via a non-mutating plan before any package state is changed, while preserving the existing enabled-package count bound.
requirements.note: R1: bulk update lists candidates from a non-mutating plan before refusal leaves state unchanged

requirements.desc: `senti plugin update` without a plugin name must ask for bulk confirmation and apply the prepared enabled-package update plan only when the answer is `y` or `yes` after trimming and case normalization.
requirements.note: R2: accepted bulk update applies the enabled-package plan

requirements.desc: `senti plugin update` without a plugin name must leave plugin package state unchanged when the answer is empty, `n`, `no`, or any other value.
requirements.note: R3: refused bulk update does not mutate commits or installed files

requirements.desc: `senti plugin update <name>` must update only the named installed plugin and must not display the bulk update confirmation.
requirements.note: R4: single update only updates the named installed plugin without bulk confirmation

requirements.desc: The retained public behavior of existing bulk update must be available through `senti plugin update` without args, including disabled-package exclusion, result rendering, and automatic upgrade skip/run conditions.
requirements.note: R5: migrated bulk update excludes disabled packages and preserves result metadata

requirements.desc: The plugin help metadata must advertise `senti plugin update [name]`; `senti plugin update-all` must not be preserved as a compatibility route and must fail without updating when invoked.
requirements.note: R6: help advertises update and update-all fails without updating

requirements.desc: When no enabled installed plugin has a newer candidate, `senti plugin update` without args should report that no package updates are available and should not show the bulk confirmation prompt.
requirements.note: R7: no-candidate bulk update reports no updates without prompting
